Find reliable vendors- Partner with trusted hair vendors that offer dropshipping services. 2. Set up your prices- Choose your selling price by adding your desired profit to the vendor’s cost. 3. Create A Website- Use Shopify to list products with high-quality hair photos and your own branding. 4. Process Orders- When a customer orders, purchase the hair from your vendor and have it shipped directly to the customer. The difference between your selling price and the vendor’s price is your profit. TIP: Occasionally order hair to yourself first so you can create content and build trust with customers.
